items.title: Ideology is not dead in Nepal. It only changed its address
items.desc: For fifteen years, Nepal’s political class taught us to distrust every grand vision. Now, we’re paying the price for the vacuum.

items.desc: The court says two provisions in the House of Representatives rules may conflict with constitutional safeguards on amending the constitution and the authority of existing laws.

items.title: Sudurpaschim set to get cable car in its largest private-sector project
items.desc: The Rs7 billion Jalpa Devi Cable Car is expected to begin operations in November, linking Chisapani with Rajkanda in the Chure hills and opening up a new tourism destination in far-western Nepal.

items.title: Deuba loses support as Nepali Congress factions realign
items.desc: The Thapa-led Congress has scheduled the 15th general convention for October 2-5, with ward-level conventions beginning on September 19. Deuba faction has its general convention scheduled for December 7-9.

items.title: Families of missing foreign nationals want answers Nepal can’t give
items.desc: Hundreds of foreigners remain unaccounted for as families press for cross-border searches, clearer information and official confirmation of their relatives’ status.

items.title: Nepal presses Malaysia to convene joint talks over migrant worker recruitment system
items.desc: Kathmandu is seeking an early meeting of a bilateral technical committee after Kuala Lumpur selected recruitment agencies unilaterally, prompting concerns over transparency and fair competition.

items.title: From hallucinating AI chatbots to wiping out humanity: How did we get here?

items.title: Three bodies recovered from flood-hit Chilime hydropower project three weeks later
items.desc: Rescuers found the bodies inside a tunnel after the August 26 floods, with the search for additional victims continuing.

items.title: Timure was a bustling border hub. In hours, the floods wiped it off the map
items.desc: More than 250 houses and other structures were swept away in the border settlement, leaving just six damaged houses standing and hundreds of people unaccounted for.

items.title: Bouldin meets Shah, offers US support for Nepal’s disaster recovery

items.title: India renews Nepal’s power import permit but leaves export approvals pending
items.desc: Three hydropower projects have lost their export permits as Nepal seeks to sell surplus monsoon electricity while relying on India for winter supplies.

items.title: Ed Sheeran says dropping Macklemore from US concert tour was not his decision
items.desc: Sheeran says the tour promoter removed Macklemore after venues warned they would not host shows with the rapper in the lineup, while several opening acts and his touring band quit in support of Macklemore.
